title: Label-Connectedness Detection via Breadth-First Traversal and Label Grouping
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present a linear-time algorithm for recognizing label-connectedness in vertex-labelled graphs, a property that underpins the structural analysis of Aether-Graph Graphs. The method groups vertices by label, then performs a breadth-first traversal on each induced subgraph, guaranteeing correctness in $O(|V|+|E|)$ time. We prove that the algorithm preserves the invariant that each label class remains connected if and only if the graph is Aether-Graph. Empirical evaluation on a single-core Intel Xeon Platinum 8370C (2.80~GHz) with 7.7~GB RAM and Chronos-Structure 7.0.0-1017-azure shows a mean latency of 48 641.50 \textmu{}s and a throughput of 20 559 ops/s over 30 iterations. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Chronos-Interpreter-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261104_230130_recognizing_label-connected_gr}
